newsitem.title: FRANCE: EMU political will keeps markets calm-Luxembourg PM.
newsitem.headline: EMU political will keeps markets calm-Luxembourg PM.

text.p: STRASBOURG, France (June 10) - Luxembourg Prime Minister Jean-Claude Juncker said on Tuesday that financial markets would only settle down over issues concerning economic and monmetary union (EMU) if the EU showed political will to see it through.
"The markets are strong if the political will is weak," he told reporters as he entered a meeting of centrist European Union leaders.
Juncker was responding to a question about market reaction on Monday to France's holding up formal agreement on the EMU stability pact because the new government wanted to study it.
Juncker, who is also Luxembourg's finance minister, will chair EU finance ministers meetings and summits of leaders when the Grand Duchy takes over the EU presidency on July 1.
